dogecoin.text: Dogecoin (DOGE) has formed a golden cross on the one-hour chart, which often signals a strong upside for the leading meme coin. The crossover comes as the DOGE price is up 8% today (July 3) and is trading at $0.174 at press time. https://t.co/lZLCaAyROM
